metadata.description: Free, read-only Claude Code skills for startup finance teams on QuickBooks Online and Stripe. Every number traces to its source rows; every skill stops when an input is missing.

plugins.name: month-end-review
plugins.description: Checks a closed month is right (cash, card, AR/AP, Stripe and payroll tie-outs; missing, duplicate and late bills; accruals, prepaids, deferred revenue; wrong accounts), then writes variance commentary and an investor-update draft with every number traced to source rows. Read-only.
